name: Lost-Foam Casting
mechanism: Molten metal replaces an expendable foam pattern in a prepared mold.
operating_requirement: Pay qualified foam patterns, coating, support media, metal and ventilation work; retain fill and residue inspection.
consequence: Supply complex blanks to machining; generic foam stock and an untested pattern cannot guarantee a sound casting.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable lost-foam casting instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.
